verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and crawling API, so automatic proxy-chain retry on anti-bot blocks is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never documents proxies, proxy rotation, or retry-on-block behavior. The community comments only ask whether residential or rotating proxies are used, which is not evidence either way.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
